notes: Parent per page: Velocity Boiler Works (Crown Boiler Co.), a subsidiary company of Burnham Holdings, Inc. Sister/similar brands listed on the page (Bryan, Burnham, New Yorker, Thermal Solutions, Thermo Pride, U.S. Boiler) are NOT claimed as sisters and no usesStylesOf is set: the page states no shared-system use, per the Bryan precedent. Only page Style 3 ships: it is the one Crown style with text-stated year digits. Page Style 1 (a literal 'Series' date such as 3/18/2010 on the rating plate) is not a serial decode and is not encoded, as with Bryan's 'Year Built' line. Page Style 2 (two-letter series, month = 1st letter, year = 2nd letter) is HELD entirely: both codes live only in chart images. The page's example list mislabels Style 3 as 'Style 2'; the section heading governs.

styles.era: Crown indirect water heaters, 8-digit or 8-digit + letter serials (year only)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year (1-based), converted to [0,2]. Page examples shown as '98 023429' and '12 122507P'; the optional trailing letter is covered by the pattern. No month is stated for this style, so it ships year-only.
